name: Yamaha YZF-R6
engine: 599 cc liquid-cooled inline four, fuel injected
intro: Yamaha's high-revving 600. Check the charging system and gearbox before anything else.

F-002.title: Test the charging system
F-002.instructions: With a charged battery, measure voltage at the battery at idle and at higher rpm. If it's low or high, test the regulator/rectifier and the stator.
F-002.reason: Stator and regulator failures are a known R6 problem.

B: On the test ride, run through every gear under load. Gearbox problems are a known R6 complaint.

recalls.what: Front side reflectors mounted at the wrong height.

known.title: Stator and regulator
known.what: Charging system faults are common on R6s.
